related.title: 光學薄膜干涉鍍膜
related.transfer: 可遷移「橢偏量測的物理量與系統邊界」與「方位校正與 Ψ、Δ 的求解」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；光學薄膜干涉鍍膜的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Ellipsometric observables and system boundaries" and "Azimuth calibration and the solution for Ψ and Δ" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Optical interference coatings must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦從 Ψ/Δ 與菲涅耳反演到偏光元件、測角儀與擬合的橢偏儀建置；光學薄膜干涉鍍膜則以以特徵矩陣與導納把多層膜設計、材料、沉積監控與光譜驗證連成可交付的鍍膜工程為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on from Ψ/Δ and Fresnel inversion to polarizing optics, goniometer and model fitting in ellipsometer construction; Optical interference coatings centres on linking multilayer design, materials, deposition monitoring and spectral verification through the characteristic matrix and admittance into deliverable coating engineering, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「反射偏振比 ρ 與入射角」與「單層膜的兩個界面」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到光學薄膜干涉鍍膜，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「入射角、偏振與公差預算」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Reflection ratio ρ and angle of incidence” and “The two interfaces of a single film”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Optical interference coatings, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Incidence angle, polarization and tolerance budget", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 橢圓偏光儀建置
history.text: 德魯德在 1887–1890 年間推導出反射偏振理論並以此量測金屬上的薄膜，是橢偏術的起點；1945 年 Rothen 建造了第一台以此命名的「橢偏儀」。1975 年 Aspnes 與 Studna 發表自動化旋轉檢偏鏡橢偏儀，使 Ψ、Δ 能以電子方式快速取得；1980–90 年代光譜型與可變角度儀器商品化（J.A. Woollam 於 1987 年成立、法國 SOPRA、美國 Rudolph 等），橢偏儀隨後成為半導體廠閘極氧化層與多層膜的例行量測工具。本課重建的是公開的物理與建置邏輯，不涉及任何廠商的專有演算法。
history.textEn: Drude derived the theory of reflected polarization between 1887 and 1890 and used it to measure thin films on metals, the origin of ellipsometry; in 1945 Rothen built the first instrument to carry the name ellipsometer. In 1975 Aspnes and Studna published the automated rotating-analyzer ellipsometer, making Ψ and Δ available electronically and quickly; spectroscopic and variable-angle instruments were commercialised in the 1980s and 1990s (J.A. Woollam founded in 1987, SOPRA in France, Rudolph in the United States), and ellipsometers then became routine tools for gate oxides and multilayer stacks in semiconductor fabs. This course reconstructs public physics and construction logic, not any vendor's proprietary algorithm.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「橢偏量測的物理量與系統邊界」到「重複性、再現性與機台比對驗收」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Ellipsometric observables and system boundaries" through "Repeatability, reproducibility and tool-matching acceptance" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.
